rationale: Cross-schema rename separates schema location from allocator ownership.
The persisted owner breadcrumb nominates every cold allocator reconstruction path.
The obligation governs allocator identity across DDL and InfoSchema ownership changes.
Generated-ID monotonicity and preexisting-row preservation expose both explicit failure and silent data loss.
A normal cold peer or restart consumes the persisted table metadata without warm allocator state.
The schedule varies only owner temperature and reconstruction path.
The warm-to-cold schedule directly exercises durable owner and high-water-mark continuity.
The constructor chooses current dbID instead of the persisted original owner.
